title: Whole Wheat Bagels with Smoked Salmon and Avocado

title: Healthy Banana Walnut Bread
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces Banana, ripe, medium size", "2 pieces Egg, raw", "100 ml Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "50 ml Honey, pure", "200 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Rolled oats", "1 tsp Baking soda", "1 tsp Baking powder", "1 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "50 g Walnuts, chopped", "30 ml Olive oil"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175 degrees Celsius and lightly grease a 9x5-inch loaf pan with a bit of olive oil or line it with parchment paper. In a large mixing bowl, mash the ripe bananas with a fork until smooth. Add the eggs, Greek yogurt, honey, and olive oil to the mashed bananas, and whisk everything together until well combined. In a separate bowl, mix the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking soda, baking powder, and cinnamon. Gradually fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture, stirring gently until just combined; be careful not to overmix. Fold in the chopped walnuts for added texture and flavor. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan and smooth the top with a spatula. Bake for 50-60 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. If the top starts to brown too quickly, tent it with aluminum foil after about 30 minutes. Let the banana bread cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely. Slice and serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Whole Wheat Honey Biscuits
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g All-purpose flour", "1 tbsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Salt", "60 g Unsalted butter, cold", "2 tbsp Honey", "180 ml Buttermilk, low-fat"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large mixing bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, baking powder, and salt. Cut the cold butter into small cubes and add it to the flour mixture. Using your fingers or a pastry cutter, work the butter into the flour until it resembles coarse crumbs with pea-sized pieces of butter remaining. In a separate small bowl, mix the honey with the buttermilk until well combined. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir gently with a wooden spoon just until a dough forms. Be careful not to overmix. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead it gently 2-3 times to bring it together. Pat the dough into a rectangle about 2 cm thick. Using a round biscuit cutter or the rim of a glass, cut out biscuits and place them on the prepared baking sheet, ensuring they are close but not touching. Gather any scraps, pat them together, and cut out additional biscuits. Bake in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes or until the tops are golden brown. Remove from the oven and let them cool slightly on a wire rack before serving.

title: Whole Wheat Blintzes with Cottage Cheese and Berries

instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, eggs, and low-fat milk until a smooth batter forms. Place a spoonful of the cottage cheese mixture in the center of each blintz, add a few mixed berries on top, then fold the blintz by tucking in the sides and rolling it up like a burrito. Serve the blintzes warm with a dollop of Greek yogurt and a few extra berries on top for garnish.

title: Veggie-Packed Breakfast Burritos with Black Beans and Avocado

title: Whole Wheat Cinnamon Rolls with Honey Glaze

instructions: Start by preheating your waffle iron according to the manufacturer's instructions. In a large mixing bowl, combine the whole grain wheat flour, all-purpose flour, baking powder, and brown sugar, stirring well to ensure there are no lumps. In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, and vegetable oil until fully combined. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir gently until just mixed; do not overmix as this can make the waffles tough. Fold in the mashed banana and chopped walnuts for added texture and flavor. Lightly grease the waffle iron with a bit of oil or non-stick spray if needed. Pour about 100 ml of batter into the center of the waffle iron, spreading it slightly if necessary. Cook for about 3-5 minutes or until the waffles are golden brown and crisp on the edges. Remove the waffles carefully and repeat with the remaining batter. Serve hot with your favorite toppings like fresh berries or a drizzle of maple syrup.

title: Savory Zucchini Bread with Feta and Herbs
ingredients_json: ["200 g Zucchini, grated", "250 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g All-purpose flour", "2 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Baking soda", "0.5 tsp Salt", "2 pieces Egg, raw", "100 ml Olive oil", "150 ml Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "100 g Feta cheese, crumbled", "2 tbsp Fresh dill, chopped", "1 tbsp Fresh parsley, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and lightly grease a 23x13 cm loaf pan with a bit of olive oil or line it with parchment paper. In a large bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt, and mix well. In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, olive oil, and Greek yogurt until smooth. Grate the zucchini and squeeze out excess moisture using a clean kitchen towel, then fold it into the wet mixture along with the crumbled feta, dill, and parsley. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir gently until just combined, being careful not to overmix. Transfer the batter into the prepared loaf pan and smooth the top with a spatula. Bake for 50-60 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean and the top is golden brown. Let the bread cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely. Slice and serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Hearty Baked Beans with Smoky Paprika and Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["400 g White beans, canned, drained", "200 g Tomatoes, canned, crushed", "1 piece Onion, medium, finely chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "1 tbsp Tomato paste", "1 dl Vegetable stock, low-sodium", "1 tbsp Maple syrup", "1 tsp Apple cider vinegar", "100 g Carrots, diced", "1 tsp Sea salt", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. In a large oven-safe pot or Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat on the stove. Add the chopped onion and diced carrots, and sauté for about 5 minutes until they begin to soften. Stir in the minced garlic, smoked paprika, and ground cumin, cooking for another 1-2 minutes until fragrant. Next, add the tomato paste, stirring to coat the vegetables, and cook for an additional minute. Pour in the crushed tomatoes, vegetable stock, maple syrup, and apple cider vinegar, mixing everything well. Add the drained white beans, sea salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine all ingredients. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, then cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven. Bake for 40-45 minutes, checking halfway to stir and ensure it doesn’t dry out; add a splash of water if needed. The beans should be tender and the flavors well melded when done. Remove from the oven, let it cool slightly, and serve warm with crusty bread or as a side dish.

title: Spicy Tomato Baked Beans with Sweet Potato

title: Hearty Beef and Vegetable Stew
ingredients_json: ["800 g Beef, stewing cuts, trimmed of fat", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 large Onion, chopped", "3 cloves Garlic, minced", "3 medium Carrots, sliced", "2 medium Potatoes, cubed", "200 g Green beans, trimmed and cut", "1.5 l Beef stock, low-sodium", "400 g Tomatoes, canned, diced", "1 tbsp Tomato paste", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "1 tsp Dried rosemary", "2 pieces Bay leaves", "100 ml Red wine (optional)", "1 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tsp Salt"]

instructions: Start by heating the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the sliced onion and minced garlic, sautéing for about 2 minutes until fragrant and the onions are translucent. Next, place the chicken thighs in the pot, skin-side down, and cook for about 5 minutes until the skin is golden brown. Flip the chicken and cook for another 3 minutes. Pour in the soy sauce, white vinegar, and water, then add the bay leaves and black peppercorns. Stir gently to combine, ensuring the chicken is coated in the marinade. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and let it simmer for 30 minutes. After 30 minutes, add the cubed potatoes to the pot, stirring to submerge them in the sauce. Continue to simmer uncovered for another 15-20 minutes, or until the chicken is tender and the potatoes are cooked through. Occasionally spoon the sauce over the chicken to keep it moist. The sauce should thicken slightly; if it’s too thin, let it simmer a bit longer. Once done, remove the bay leaves and serve the chicken and potatoes hot with the savory sauce drizzled over the top.

title: Hearty Chicken and Herb Dumplings Stew
ingredients_json: ["500 g Chicken breast, skinless, boneless", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 medium Onion, chopped", "2 medium Carrots, sliced", "2 stalks Celery, sliced", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 l Chicken broth, low-sodium", "200 ml Water", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "1 tsp Dried rosemary", "200 g All-purpose flour", "2 tsp Baking powder", "100 ml Milk, low-fat", "1 large Egg, raw", "150 g Frozen peas", "1 tbsp Fresh parsley, chopped"]
instructions: Start by heating the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the chopped onion, sliced carrots, and celery, and sauté for about 5 minutes until they begin to soften. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Next, add the chicken breast pieces to the pot and cook until lightly browned on all sides, which should take about 5-7 minutes. Pour in the chicken broth and water, then add the thyme and rosemary. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and let it simmer for 20 minutes. While the stew simmers, prepare the dumplings by mixing the flour and baking powder in a bowl. In a separate small bowl, whisk together the milk and egg, then pour this into the flour mixture and stir until just combined to form a sticky dough. After the stew has simmered, stir in the frozen peas. Drop spoonfuls of the dumpling dough into the simmering stew, spacing them evenly. Cover the pot again and cook for an additional 10-12 minutes, or until the dumplings are fluffy and cooked through. Finally, sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top before serving to add a fresh touch.

title: Oven-Baked Chicken Cordon Bleu with Dijon Cream Sauce
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces Chicken breast, boneless, skinless (150 g each)", "4 slices Ham, lean, cooked (30 g each)", "4 slices Cheese, Swiss, low-fat (25 g each)", "50 g Breadcrumbs, whole wheat", "1 piece Egg, raw", "30 ml Milk, low-fat", "30 g Flour, all-purpose", "15 ml Olive oil", "100 ml Chicken broth, low-sodium", "100 ml Cream, light (18% fat)", "15 g Dijon mustard", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. Start by preparing the chicken breasts: use a sharp knife to cut a pocket into the side of each breast, being careful not to slice all the way through. Stuff each pocket with one slice of ham and one slice of Swiss cheese, then secure the opening with toothpicks if necessary. In a small bowl, whisk the egg with the milk to create an egg wash. Set up three shallow dishes: one with flour, one with the egg wash, and one with breadcrumbs seasoned with a pinch of salt and pepper. Dredge each stuffed chicken breast first in flour, shaking off excess, then dip into the egg wash, and finally coat with breadcrumbs. Heat olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium heat. Sear the chicken breasts for about 3 minutes on each side until golden brown, then transfer the skillet to the preheated oven. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the internal temperature of the chicken reaches 74°C. While the chicken bakes, prepare the Dijon cream sauce. In a small saucepan, combine chicken broth, light cream, and Dijon mustard over low heat. Stir continuously for about 5 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly, then season with a pinch of salt and pepper. Once the chicken is done, remove it from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes. Serve each chicken breast with a drizzle of the Dijon cream sauce on top.

title: Spicy Black Bean and Sweet Potato Empanadas

title: Grilled Flat Iron Steak with Rosemary and Garlic
ingredients_json: ["600 g Flat Iron Steak, raw", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "3 cloves Garlic, minced", "2 sprigs Rosemary, fresh", "1 tsp Sea salt", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "400 g Sweet potatoes, raw", "200 g Green beans, fresh", "1 tbsp Butter, unsalted"]

In the last few minutes of grilling, quickly steam or blanch the green beans in boiling water for 3-4 minutes until bright green and tender-crisp, then toss them with a small knob of butter. Slice the steak against the grain into thin strips and serve it alongside the grilled sweet potatoes and buttery green beans for a balanced and flavorful meal.

title: Grilled Flat Iron Steak with Chimichurri and Roasted Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["600 g Flat Iron Steak, raw", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Sea salt, coarse", "1 tsp Black pepper, ground", "200 g Carrots, raw", "200 g Zucchini, raw", "200 g Red bell pepper, raw", "1 tbsp Rosemary, dried", "50 g Parsley, fresh", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 piece Red chili pepper, raw", "50 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "2 tbsp Red wine vinegar", "1 tsp Oregano, dried"]

title: Mediterranean Chicken and Hummus Flatbreads
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces Whole wheat flatbreads, medium size", "300 g Chicken breast, skinless, boneless", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Paprika, ground", "1 tsp Cumin, ground", "200 g Hummus, store-bought", "1 piece Cucumber, medium, sliced", "2 pieces Tomatoes, medium, sliced", "100 g Red onion, thinly sliced", "50 g Feta cheese, crumbled", "2 dl Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "1 piece Lemon, juice only", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "30 g Fresh parsley, chopped"]
instructions: Start by marinating the chicken. In a bowl, mix 1 tablespoon of olive oil with paprika, cumin, half of the minced garlic, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Add the chicken breasts and cook for about 5-6 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and cooked through with an internal temperature of 75°C. Remove the chicken from the skillet and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing it into thin strips. While the chicken rests, prepare the yogurt sauce by combining Greek yogurt, lemon juice, the remaining garlic, and a handful of chopped parsley in a small bowl. Stir well and set aside. Warm the whole wheat flatbreads in the oven at 180°C for about 2-3 minutes or until slightly crisp. To assemble, spread a generous layer of hummus on each flatbread. title: Mediterranean Chickpea and Veggie Flatbreads
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "150 ml Water, lukewarm", "1 tsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Baking powder", "200 g Chickpeas, canned, drained", "1 piece Red bell pepper, medium, diced", "1 piece Zucchini, medium, sliced thinly", "100 g Cherry tomatoes, halved", "50 g Red onion, thinly sliced", "100 g Feta cheese, crumbled", "2 tbsp Olive oil, extra virgin", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1 clove Garlic, minced", "1 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh"]
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the whole wheat flour and baking powder. Gradually add the lukewarm water and 1 teaspoon of olive oil, mixing until a soft dough forms. Meanwhile, prepare the topping by heating 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the diced red bell pepper, sliced zucchini, and red onion, sautéing for about 5-7 minutes until they soften. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Add the drained chickpeas, cherry tomatoes, dried oregano, and lemon juice, cooking for an additional 3 minutes to combine the flavors, then set aside. Divide the dough into 4 equal portions and roll each piece into a thin, round flatbread, about 20 cm in diameter. Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat and cook each flatbread for about 2-3 minutes on each side until golden brown spots appear and they are cooked through. title: Mediterranean Veggie and Hummus Flatbreads

title: Spiced Chickpea and Spinach Flatbreads with Yogurt Sauce
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "100 ml Water, lukewarm", "1 tsp Olive oil", "400 g Chickpeas, canned, drained", "1 tbsp Ground cumin", "1 tsp Ground coriander", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 piece Onion, medium, finely chopped", "100 g Fresh spinach, chopped", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "1 tbsp Lemon juice", "1 tsp Mint, dried", "2 tbsp Olive oil, for cooking"]
instructions: Start by preparing the flatbread dough. In a large mixing bowl, combine the whole wheat flour with lukewarm water and 1 teaspoon of olive oil. Mix until a soft dough forms, then knead it on a lightly floured surface for about 5 minutes until smooth. Cover the dough with a damp cloth and let it rest for 30 minutes. title: Classic French Onion Soup with Gruyère Croutons
ingredients_json: ["1.5 kg Onions, yellow, raw", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "50 g Butter, unsalted", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1.5 l Beef stock, low-sodium", "200 ml White wine, dry", "2 tsp Thyme, dried", "1 piece Bay leaf, dried", "200 g Baguette, whole grain", "150 g Gruyère cheese, grated"]
instructions: Start by peeling and thinly slicing the onions. In a large, heavy-bottomed pot, heat the olive oil and butter over medium heat. Once the butter has melted, add the sliced onions and stir to coat them in the fat. Cook the onions for about 30-40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they are deeply caramelized and golden brown. If they start to stick, lower the heat slightly and add a splash of water to deglaze the pan. Once caramelized, add the minced garlic and cook for another 1-2 minutes until fragrant. Pour in the white wine to deglaze, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot, and let it simmer for 3-4 minutes. Add the beef stock, thyme, and bay leaf, then bring the soup to a gentle boil. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and let it simmer for 20-25 minutes to allow the flavors to meld. While the soup simmers, preheat your oven to 200°C. Slice the baguette into 1 cm thick rounds and place them on a baking sheet. Toast the bread in the oven for about 5 minutes until lightly crisp. Remove the bay leaf from the soup, then ladle the soup into oven-safe bowls. Place a slice or two of toasted baguette on top of each bowl and sprinkle generously with grated Gruyère cheese. Place the bowls on a baking tray and broil in the oven for 3-5 minutes, or until the cheese is melted, bubbly, and slightly golden. Watch closely to avoid burning. Serve immediately, ensuring the soup is piping hot.

instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Start by preparing the pork ribs. In a small bowl, mix the honey, soy sauce, minced garlic, paprika, and black pepper to create a glaze. Rub the ribs with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, then coat them evenly with half of the honey glaze mixture. Place the ribs in a large roasting pan, bone side down. Next, prepare the vegetables. Wash and cut the potatoes into wedges, peel and slice the carrots into sticks, and trim the Brussels sprouts. Toss the vegetables in the remaining olive oil, rosemary, and sea salt. Arrange the vegetables around the ribs in the roasting pan. Place the pan in the preheated oven and roast for about 1.5 hours. After the first 45 minutes, brush the ribs with the remaining glaze to enhance the flavor and caramelization. Check the ribs for tenderness; the meat should pull away from the bone easily. If needed, roast for an additional 15–20 minutes. Once done, remove from the oven, cover loosely with foil, and let the ribs rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving with the roasted vegetables.

title: Turkey and Vegetable Pot Pie with Whole Wheat Crust
ingredients_json: ["400 g Turkey breast, skinless, diced", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 medium Onion, chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "150 g Carrots, diced", "150 g Peas, frozen", "100 g Green beans, chopped", "2 dl Chicken broth, low sodium", "2 tbsp Whole wheat flour", "2 dl Milk, low-fat", "200 g Whole wheat flour, for crust", "100 g Butter, unsalted, cold", "5 tbsp Water, cold", "1 tsp Thyme, dried", "1 tsp Salt", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Start by preheating your oven to 200°C. In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and minced garlic, sautéing for about 3 minutes until they soften and become fragrant. Stir in the diced turkey breast and cook for another 5 minutes until lightly browned. Add the carrots, peas, and green beans, mixing well to combine. Sprinkle the whole wheat flour over the mixture and stir for 1 minute to coat evenly. Gradually pour in the chicken broth and low-fat milk, stirring constantly to avoid lumps. Add thyme, salt, and black pepper. Let the mixture simmer for 5-7 minutes until it thickens into a creamy filling. Remove from heat and set aside. For the crust, combine the whole wheat flour with cold butter in a bowl, using your fingers or a pastry cutter to mix until it resembles coarse crumbs. Gradually add the cold water, one tablespoon at a time, until a dough forms. Roll out the dough on a lightly floured surface to fit your pie dish. Transfer the turkey and vegetable filling into a pie dish, then cover with the rolled-out dough, crimping the edges to seal. Cut a few slits on top to allow steam to escape. Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes or until the crust is golden brown. Let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.

instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Start by cooking the brown rice according to package instructions, ensuring it’s slightly undercooked as it will continue to cook in the oven. While the rice cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and minced garlic, sautéing for about 2-3 minutes until they soften and become fragrant. Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces, add them to the skillet, and cook for 5-7 minutes until browned on all sides. Stir in the sliced carrots, broccoli florets, and diced red bell pepper, cooking for another 5 minutes until the vegetables start to soften. Pour in the chicken broth and milk, stirring well to combine. Season with paprika, black pepper, and salt, and let the mixture simmer for 3-4 minutes. In a large casserole dish, mix the partially cooked rice with the chicken and vegetable mixture. Sprinkle the shredded cheddar cheese evenly over the top. Cover the dish with foil and bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly and the rice is fully cooked. Remove the foil for the last 5 minutes of baking to get a golden top. Let the casserole rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.

title: Creamy Mushroom and Spinach Risotto

title: Lemon Zest Angel Food Cake with Fresh Berries
ingredients_json: ["12 pieces Egg whites, raw", "300 g Sugar, white, granulated", "100 g Cake flour, sifted", "1 tsp Cream of tartar", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "1 tbsp Lemon zest, fresh", "2 dl Lemon juice, fresh", "200 g Strawberries, fresh", "150 g Blueberries, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C and ensure you have an ungreased angel food cake pan ready. In a large mixing bowl, beat the egg whites with an electric mixer on medium speed until they become frothy. Add the cream of tartar and continue beating until soft peaks form. Gradually add the granulated sugar, about 2 tablespoons at a time, while beating on high speed until stiff peaks form and the mixture is glossy. Gently fold in the vanilla extract and lemon zest with a rubber spatula. Sift the cake flour over the egg white mixture in small batches, folding it in gently after each addition to avoid deflating the batter. Spoon the batter into the ungreased angel food cake pan, smoothing the top lightly. Bake in the preheated oven for 35 to 40 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and springs back when lightly touched. Immediately invert the pan onto a cooling rack and let it cool completely for about 1 hour before removing the cake from the pan. While the cake cools, prepare a light lemon glaze by mixing the fresh lemon juice with a small amount of sugar to taste, heating it slightly if needed to dissolve the sugar. Drizzle the glaze over the cooled cake. Serve each slice topped with fresh strawberries and blueberries for a refreshing contrast.

title: Classic Spiced Apple Pie with Whole Wheat Crust
ingredients_json: ["800 g Apples, raw, with skin", "100 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g All-purpose flour", "120 g Unsalted butter, cold", "50 g Brown sugar", "50 g Granulated sugar", "1 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh", "1 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "0.5 tsp Nutmeg, ground", "1 piece Egg, raw", "2 tbsp Water, cold", "1 tbsp Cornstarch"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C. Start by preparing the pie crust. In a large bowl, combine the whole wheat flour and all-purpose flour. Cut the cold butter into small cubes and add it to the flour mixture. Use your fingers or a pastry cutter to blend the butter into the flour until it resembles coarse crumbs. Add the cold water, one tablespoon at a time, mixing until the dough comes together. Divide the dough into two equal portions, wrap in plastic, and chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes. Meanwhile, peel, core, and slice the apples into thin pieces. In a large bowl, toss the apple slices with lemon juice, brown sugar, granulated sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, and cornstarch until well coated. Set aside. Roll out one portion of the dough on a lightly floured surface to fit a 23 cm pie dish. Carefully transfer it to the dish, pressing it into the bottom and sides. Pour the apple mixture into the crust, spreading it evenly. Roll out the second portion of dough and place it over the apples. Trim any excess dough, then crimp the edges to seal. Cut a few slits in the top crust to allow steam to escape. Beat the egg with a teaspoon of water and brush it over the top crust for a golden finish. Bake the pie for 50-60 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is bubbling. If the edges brown too quickly, cover them with foil after 30 minutes. Let the pie cool for at least 2 hours before serving to allow the filling to set.

instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Start by peeling and slicing the apples into thin wedges and place them in a large mixing bowl. Add the frozen mixed berries, honey, and cinnamon to the apples, and mix well to combine. Transfer this fruit mixture into a medium-sized baking dish, spreading it out evenly. In a separate bowl, combine the whole grain oats, almond flour, brown sugar, and baking powder. Cut the cold butter into small pieces and rub it into the dry mixture with your fingers until it resembles coarse crumbs. Gradually pour in the milk, stirring until a thick batter forms. Spoon this oat mixture over the fruit in the baking dish, spreading it out to cover most of the surface but leaving some gaps for the fruit to bubble through. Bake in the preheated oven for 35-40 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the fruit mixture is bubbling. Let it cool for about 10 minutes before serving to allow the juices to settle.

title: Classic Vanilla Creme Brulee with a Healthy Twist
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces Egg yolk, raw", "400 ml Milk, low-fat 1.5%", "100 ml Cream, light 18% fat", "50 g Sugar, white granulated", "1 tsp Vanilla extract, pure", "20 g Sugar, brown for topping"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 150°C. In a medium bowl, whisk the egg yolks and 50 grams of white sugar together until the mixture is pale and slightly thickened. In a small saucepan, heat the low-fat milk and light cream over medium heat until it just begins to simmer, but do not let it boil. Remove from heat and slowly pour the warm milk mixture into the egg yolk mixture, whisking constantly to prevent curdling. Stir in the vanilla extract. Strain the mixture through a fine sieve into a jug to remove any lumps. Divide the custard evenly among four ramekins. Place the ramekins in a deep baking dish and fill the dish with hot water until it reaches halfway up the sides of the ramekins. Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until the custards are set but still have a slight wobble in the center. Remove from the oven and let them cool to room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours to chill completely. Before serving, sprinkle 5 grams of brown sugar evenly over the top of each custard. Use a kitchen torch to caramelize the sugar until it forms a crisp, golden crust. If you don’t have a torch, place the ramekins under a preheated broiler for 1-2 minutes, watching closely to avoid burning. Let the sugar harden for a minute before serving.

instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. In a medium bowl, mix the almond flour, melted coconut oil, and honey until a dough forms. Press the mixture evenly into the bottom and sides of a 23 cm pie dish to form the crust. Bake the crust for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown, then remove from the oven and let it cool completely. While the crust cools, prepare the filling. In a small saucepan, combine the water, cornstarch, and granulated sugar over medium heat. Stir constantly until the mixture thickens and becomes glossy, which should take about 3-5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla extract. Allow the glaze to cool slightly. Arrange the sliced strawberries in the cooled almond crust, starting from the center and working your way out in a circular pattern. Pour the cooled glaze evenly over the strawberries, ensuring they are all coated. Refrigerate the pie for at least 2 hours to set. Before serving, dollop small spoonfuls of Greek yogurt on top for a creamy contrast. Slice and enjoy!

title: Fresh Strawberry Yogurt Pie
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Unsalted butter, cold", "50 ml Cold water", "500 g Fresh strawberries, hulled", "200 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "50 g Honey", "1 piece Egg, raw", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "10 g Cornstarch"]
instructions: Start by preparing the pie crust. In a large bowl, combine the whole wheat flour and cold butter, cutting the butter into the flour using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Gradually add the cold water, mixing with a fork until the dough starts to come together. Form the dough into a ball, wrap it in plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Preheat your oven to 180°C. Roll out the chilled dough on a lightly floured surface to fit a 23 cm pie dish. Transfer the dough to the dish, trim the edges, and prick the bottom with a fork. Bake the crust for about 15 minutes or until lightly golden, then set aside to cool. For the filling, blend half of the strawberries with the Greek yogurt, honey, vanilla extract, and cornstarch until smooth. Pour this mixture into the cooled pie crust. Bake for another 25 minutes at 160°C, or until the filling is set but still slightly jiggly in the center. Allow the pie to cool completely, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours to firm up. Before serving, top the pie with the remaining fresh strawberries, arranging them in a decorative pattern. Slice and serve chilled.

title: Light and Fluffy Strawberry Shortcakes with Greek Yogurt Cream
ingredients_json: ["200 g whole wheat flour", "50 g almond flour", "1 tbsp baking powder", "30 g coconut sugar", "60 g unsalted butter, cold", "150 ml low-fat milk", "500 g fresh strawberries, hulled and sliced", "2 tbsp honey", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, non-fat", "1 tsp vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. In a large mixing bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, almond flour, baking powder, and coconut sugar. Cut the cold butter into small cubes and rub it into the dry ingredients using your fingertips until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Gradually pour in the low-fat milk, stirring with a fork until a soft dough forms. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead it gently just until it comes together. Roll the dough to about 2 cm thickness and use a round cutter to cut out 6 shortcakes. Place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until golden brown on top. While the shortcakes are baking, mix the sliced strawberries with honey in a bowl and set aside to let the juices release. In another bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt and vanilla extract to make a light cream. Once the shortcakes have cooled slightly, split them in half. Spoon some of the strawberry mixture onto the bottom half, add a dollop of Greek yogurt cream, and top with the other half of the shortcake. Serve immediately for the best texture.

title: Light Strawberry Shortcakes with Honey Whipped Cream
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Almond flour", "1 tbsp Baking powder", "2 tbsp Honey", "60 g Unsalted butter, cold", "150 ml Greek yogurt, low-fat", "400 g Fresh strawberries, hulled and sliced", "200 ml Heavy cream, 30% fat", "1 tbsp Vanilla extract", "30 g Powdered sugar"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. In a large mixing bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, almond flour, and baking powder. Cut the cold butter into small pieces and rub it into the flour mixture with your fingertips until it resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in 1 tablespoon of honey and the Greek yogurt, mixing until a soft dough forms. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat it into a 2 cm thick rectangle. Cut out 6 rounds using a biscuit cutter and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 12-15 minutes or until golden brown, then let them cool on a wire rack. While the shortcakes bake, prepare the strawberries by tossing them with 1 tablespoon of honey in a bowl and set aside to macerate. For the whipped cream, beat the heavy cream with the remaining tablespoon of honey, vanilla extract, and powdered sugar in a chilled bowl until soft peaks form. To assemble, split the cooled shortcakes in half, spoon some strawberries over the bottom half, add a dollop of whipped cream, and top with the other half of the shortcake. Serve immediately.

title: Healthy Almond Sugar Cookies
ingredients_json: ["200 g Almond flour", "50 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Coconut sugar", "100 g Unsalted butter, softened", "1 piece Egg, raw", "5 ml Vanilla extract", "2 g Baking soda", "1 g Salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175 degrees Celsius and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large mixing bowl, cream together the softened butter and coconut sugar until light and fluffy, which should take about 2-3 minutes with a hand mixer. Add the egg and vanilla extract, and mix until fully incorporated. In a separate bowl, whisk together the almond flour, whole wheat flour, baking soda, and salt. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture, stirring until a soft dough forms. Roll the dough into small balls, about 1 tablespoon each, and place them on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 5 cm apart. Flatten each ball slightly with the bottom of a glass or your hand. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the edges are golden but the centers are still soft. Let the cookies cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely. Enjoy these healthier sugar cookies with a subtle almond flavor!

title: Spiced Sweet Potato Pie with Cinnamon Crust
ingredients_json: ["500 g Sweet potato, peeled and cubed", "200 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Unsalted butter, cold", "50 ml Ice water", "2 pieces Egg, raw", "100 ml Milk, whole", "50 g Brown sugar", "1 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "0.5 tsp Nutmeg, ground", "0.5 tsp Vanilla extract", "1 pinch Salt"]
instructions: Start by preparing the crust. In a large bowl, combine the whole wheat flour with a pinch of salt. Cut the cold butter into small cubes and rub it into the flour using your fingertips until the mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs. Gradually add the ice water, mixing with a fork until the dough comes together. Shape it into a disc, wrap it in plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Meanwhile, boil the sweet potato cubes in a pot of water for about 15 minutes or until tender. Drain and let them cool slightly, then mash them until smooth in a large bowl. Preheat your oven to 180°C. In the bowl with the mashed sweet potato, whisk in the eggs, milk, brown sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, and vanilla extract until well combined. Roll out the chilled dough on a lightly floured surface to fit a 23 cm pie dish. Transfer the dough to the dish, pressing it into the bottom and sides, and trim any excess. Pour the sweet potato filling into the crust. Bake in the preheated oven for 45–50 minutes, or until the filling is set and the crust is golden brown. Check for doneness by inserting a toothpick in the center; it should come out clean. Let the pie cool completely on a wire rack before slicing and serving.

title: Spiced Sweet Potato Pie with Maple Glaze
ingredients_json: ["500 g Sweet potato, raw, peeled", "200 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Unsalted butter, chilled", "2 pieces Egg, raw", "100 ml Milk, whole", "80 g Brown sugar", "1 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "0.5 tsp Nutmeg, ground", "0.5 tsp Vanilla extract", "50 ml Maple syrup", "1 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh"]

Bake the pie in the preheated oven for 45-50 minutes, or until the filling is set and the crust is golden brown. While the pie is baking, prepare the maple glaze by combining the maple syrup and lemon juice in a small saucepan over low heat. Stir for 2-3 minutes until slightly thickened. Once the pie is done, let it cool for 10 minutes, then brush the maple glaze over the top for a glossy finish. Allow the pie to cool completely before slicing and serving.

title: Lightened-Up Coffee Tiramisu with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["200 g Ladyfingers, whole grain", "250 ml Espresso, brewed and cooled", "500 g Greek yogurt, non-fat", "200 g Mascarpone cheese, light", "50 g Honey, pure", "1 tsp Vanilla extract, pure", "30 g Cocoa powder, unsweetened", "100 ml Water, cold"]
instructions: Start by brewing the espresso and letting it cool to room temperature. In a large mixing bowl, combine the Greek yogurt, light mascarpone cheese, honey, and vanilla extract. Beat the mixture with an electric mixer on medium speed for about 2 minutes until it becomes smooth and creamy. In a separate small bowl, mix the cooled espresso with cold water to dilute it slightly. Take a rectangular dish (about 20x30 cm) and begin assembling the tiramisu. Quickly dip each ladyfinger into the espresso mixture, ensuring they are moist but not soggy, and place them in a single layer at the bottom of the dish. Spread half of the yogurt-mascarpone cream over the ladyfingers using a spatula. Repeat the process with another layer of dipped ladyfingers and top with the remaining cream. Smooth the top layer with a spatula. Cover the dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or ideally overnight, to allow the flavors to meld and the dessert to set. Before serving, dust the top with unsweetened cocoa powder through a fine sieve for an even finish. Cut into portions and serve chilled.

ingredients_json: ["200 g Dates, pitted and chopped", "100 g Almonds, raw and roughly chopped", "50 g Walnuts, raw and chopped", "100 g Rolled oats", "50 g Honey", "30 g Coconut oil", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "2 g Cinnamon, ground"]
instructions: Begin by lining a 20x20 cm baking dish with parchment paper and set it aside. In a food processor, pulse the pitted dates until they form a sticky paste, which should take about 1-2 minutes. Transfer the date paste to a large mixing bowl. Add the chopped almonds, walnuts, and rolled oats to the bowl, mixing everything together until well combined. In a small saucepan over low heat, melt the coconut oil and honey together, stirring constantly for about 1 minute until fully combined. Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla extract and ground cinnamon. Pour this liquid mixture over the date and nut mixture, stirring thoroughly to ensure everything is evenly coated. Transfer the mixture into the prepared baking dish, pressing it down firmly with the back of a spoon or your hands to create an even layer. Refrigerate the mixture for at least 2 hours or until it is completely set. Once set, remove from the dish using the parchment paper and cut into 12 equal bars. Store the toffee bars in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to a week.

title: Healthy Almond Toffee Crunch
ingredients_json: ["100 g Almonds, whole, raw", "150 g Coconut sugar", "50 g Unsalted butter", "2 tbsp Honey", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "50 g Dark chocolate, 70% cocoa, chopped", "1 pinch Sea salt"]
instructions: Line a baking tray with parchment paper and set aside. In a heavy-bottomed saucepan, combine the coconut sugar, unsalted butter, and honey over medium heat. Stir continuously until the mixture melts and starts to bubble. Allow it to cook for about 5-7 minutes, or until it reaches a deep golden color and a candy thermometer reads 140°C, which is the hard crack stage. Remove from heat and quickly stir in the vanilla extract and chopped almonds. Pour the mixture onto the prepared tray, spreading it into an even layer with a spatula. Let it cool for about 10 minutes until it begins to harden. While it’s still slightly warm, sprinkle the chopped dark chocolate over the top and let it melt for a couple of minutes. Spread the melted chocolate evenly with a spatula and sprinkle a pinch of sea salt on top for a finishing touch. Allow the toffee to cool completely at room temperature, which should take about 1-2 hours, or speed up the process by placing it in the refrigerator for 30 minutes. Once fully set, break the toffee into bite-sized pieces and store in an airtight container.

title: Healthy Almond Toffee Bars
ingredients_json: ["100 g Almonds, raw, chopped", "50 g Rolled oats", "80 g Honey", "50 g Coconut oil", "30 g Dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "2 tbsp Chia seeds"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 160°C. Line a small baking tray with parchment paper. In a medium bowl, mix the chopped almonds, rolled oats, and chia seeds. In a small saucepan over low heat, combine the honey and coconut oil, stirring until fully melted and blended. Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla extract. Pour the wet mixture over the dry ingredients and mix well to ensure everything is evenly coated. Spread the mixture onto the prepared tray, pressing it down firmly into an even layer about 1 cm thick. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown at the edges. Remove from the oven and let it cool completely. Once cooled, melt the dark chocolate in a microwave or over a double boiler, then drizzle it over the toffee slab. Allow the chocolate to set at room temperature or in the fridge. Once set, cut into 8 even bars and serve.

title: Healthy Almond Toffee with Dark Chocolate
ingredients_json: ["100 g Almonds, raw", "100 g Coconut sugar", "50 g Unsalted butter", "100 g Dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "50 ml Water"]
instructions: Line a baking tray with parchment paper and set aside. In a medium saucepan, combine the coconut sugar, unsalted butter, and water over medium heat. Stir constantly until the mixture melts and starts to bubble. Continue cooking for about 5-7 minutes, or until the mixture reaches a deep amber color and a candy thermometer reads 150°C, indicating the hard crack stage. Remove from heat and quickly stir in the vanilla extract and raw almonds. Pour the hot mixture onto the prepared tray, spreading it into an even layer with a spatula. Let it cool for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, melt the dark chocolate in a heatproof bowl over a double boiler or in the microwave in 20-second bursts, stirring until smooth. Pour the melted chocolate over the cooled toffee layer and spread it evenly. Allow the toffee to fully set at room temperature for about 2 hours or in the refrigerator for 30 minutes. Once set, break into pieces and store in an airtight container.

title: Healthy Almond Toffee Bites
ingredients_json: ["100 g Almonds, whole, raw", "50 g Rolled oats", "100 g Dates, pitted", "50 g Coconut oil", "2 tbsp Maple syrup", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "50 g Dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "1 pinch Sea salt"]
instructions: Start by toasting the almonds in a dry skillet over medium heat for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally until they are fragrant and lightly golden. Remove from heat and let them cool slightly. In a food processor, pulse the toasted almonds and rolled oats together until they form a coarse crumb texture. Add the pitted dates, melted coconut oil, maple syrup, and vanilla extract to the processor, then blend until the mixture comes together into a sticky dough. Line a small baking tray or dish with parchment paper and press the mixture evenly into the tray to form a 1 cm thick layer. Refrigerate for about 30 minutes to firm up. Meanwhile, melt the dark chocolate in a heatproof bowl over a double boiler or in the microwave in 20-second bursts, stirring until smooth. Remove the toffee mixture from the fridge, cut it into bite-sized squares, and drizzle the melted chocolate over the top. Sprinkle a pinch of sea salt over the chocolate for an extra flavor boost. Return to the fridge for another 15 minutes to set the chocolate. Once fully set, store the toffee bites in an airtight container in the fridge for up to a week.

title: Almond and Berry Chocolate Torte
ingredients_json: ["200 g Almonds, ground", "150 g Dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "100 g Unsalted butter", "3 piece Egg, raw", "100 g Honey", "50 g Whole wheat flour", "1 tsp Baking powder", "200 g Mixed berries, frozen (e.g., raspberries and blueberries)", "50 ml Orange juice, fresh squeezed"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Grease a 20 cm springform pan and line the bottom with parchment paper. In a heatproof bowl, melt the dark chocolate and butter together over a double boiler, stirring occasionally until smooth, then set aside to cool slightly. In a separate large bowl, whisk the eggs and honey together until light and fluffy, which should take about 3 minutes with an electric mixer. Fold the cooled chocolate mixture into the egg and honey mix gently. Sift the whole wheat flour and baking powder together, then fold them into the wet mixture along with the ground almonds until just combined. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top. Bake for 25-30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out with a few moist crumbs. Let the torte cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely. Meanwhile, heat the mixed berries with the orange juice in a small saucepan over low heat for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the berries soften and release their juices. Let this berry compote cool slightly before spooning it over the cooled torte just before serving.

title: Almond and Raspberry Layer Torte
ingredients_json: ["200 g Almond flour", "150 g Whole wheat flour", "4 piece Egg, raw", "100 g Honey", "50 g Coconut oil, melted", "1 tsp Baking powder", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, non-fat", "150 g Raspberries, fresh", "50 g Almonds, sliced", "1 tsp Vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and lightly grease two 20 cm round cake tins with a bit of coconut oil. In a large mixing bowl, combine the almond flour, whole wheat flour, and baking powder. In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, honey, melted coconut oil, and vanilla extract until smooth. Gradually fold the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients, stirring until just combined to avoid overmixing. Divide the batter evenly between the two prepared tins and smooth the tops with a spatula. Bake for 25-30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean and the tops are golden brown. Let the cakes cool completely in the tins before removing them. Once cooled, place one cake layer on a serving plate and spread half of the Greek yogurt over the top. Arrange half of the raspberries evenly over the yogurt. Place the second cake layer on top and repeat with the remaining yogurt and raspberries. Sprinkle the sliced almonds over the top for a decorative touch. Refrigerate the torte for at least 30 minutes before serving to allow the layers to set.

title: Almond and Berry Chocolate Torte
ingredients_json: ["200 g Almonds, ground", "100 g Dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "4 piece Egg, raw", "80 g Honey", "50 g Coconut oil", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "150 g Mixed berries, frozen", "50 g Whole wheat flour", "1 tsp Baking powder"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Grease a 20 cm springform pan with a little coconut oil and line the bottom with parchment paper. In a heatproof bowl, melt the dark chocolate and coconut oil together over a double boiler, stirring until smooth, then set aside to cool slightly. In a large mixing bowl, whisk the eggs and honey together until light and fluffy, which should take about 3 minutes with an electric mixer. Add the vanilla extract and the melted chocolate mixture, mixing until well combined. Gently fold in the ground almonds, whole wheat flour, and baking powder until just incorporated. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Let the torte cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely. Once cooled, top with the mixed berries, spreading them evenly over the surface. Serve chilled or at room temperature for the best texture.

title: Almond and Raspberry Torte with Dark Chocolate
ingredients_json: ["200 g Almond flour", "100 g Whole wheat flour", "4 piece Egg, raw", "100 g Honey", "50 g Coconut oil, melted", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, non-fat", "200 g Raspberries, fresh", "50 g Dark chocolate, 70% cocoa, chopped", "1 tsp Baking powder", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "50 ml Almond milk, unsweetened"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and grease a 23 cm springform pan with a little coconut oil. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the almond flour, whole wheat flour, and baking powder. In a separate bowl, beat the eggs with the honey until light and fluffy, which should take about 3 minutes with an electric mixer on medium speed. Add the melted coconut oil, Greek yogurt, vanilla extract, and almond milk to the egg mixture, stirring until fully combined. Gradually fold the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients, mixing gently to avoid overworking the batter. Fold in half of the raspberries carefully so they don’t break apart too much. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top with a spatula. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean and the top is golden brown. Let the torte cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely. Once cooled, melt the dark chocolate in a heatproof bowl over a double boiler or in short bursts in the microwave, stirring frequently to prevent burning. Drizzle the melted chocolate over the top of the torte and decorate with the remaining raspberries. Slice and serve once the chocolate has set slightly, which takes about 15 minutes at room temperature.

title: Almond and Raspberry Torte with Honey Glaze
ingredients_json: ["200 g Almond flour", "100 g Whole wheat flour", "4 piece Egg, raw", "100 g Honey", "50 g Unsalted butter", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, non-fat", "200 g Raspberries, fresh", "1 tsp Baking powder", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "50 ml Almond milk, unsweetened"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and grease a 23 cm springform pan with a bit of butter or line it with parchment paper. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the almond flour, whole wheat flour, and baking powder until well combined. In a separate bowl, beat the eggs with 80 g of the honey until light and fluffy, which should take about 3 minutes with an electric mixer on medium speed. Melt the butter and let it cool slightly before adding it to the egg mixture along with the Greek yogurt, vanilla extract, and almond milk, stirring until everything is fully incorporated. Gradually fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture, stirring gently to avoid overmixing. Pour half of the batter into the prepared pan, then scatter half of the raspberries evenly over the top. Add the remaining batter and smooth the surface with a spatula. Bake in the preheated oven for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean and the top is golden brown. While the torte is baking, warm the remaining 20 g of honey in a small saucepan over low heat until it becomes runny. Once the torte is out of the oven, let it cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then brush the top with the warm honey glaze. Decorate with the remaining raspberries before serving. Allow the torte to cool completely before slicing for the best texture.

title: Dark Chocolate Almond Truffles
ingredients_json: ["200 g Dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "100 ml Coconut milk, full fat", "50 g Almonds, ground", "30 g Honey, raw", "20 g Cocoa powder, unsweetened, for dusting"]
instructions: Begin by finely chopping the dark chocolate and placing it into a heatproof bowl. In a small saucepan, heat the coconut milk over medium heat until it just starts to simmer, then pour it over the chopped chocolate. Let it sit for a minute to allow the chocolate to melt, then stir gently until you have a smooth, glossy mixture. Add the ground almonds and honey to the chocolate mixture, stirring well to combine all ingredients. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for about 2 hours, or until the mixture is firm enough to scoop. Once chilled, use a teaspoon to scoop out small portions of the mixture and roll them into balls with your hands. If the mixture sticks, lightly dampen your hands with water. Finally, roll each truffle in the cocoa powder to coat evenly. Store the truffles in an airtight container in the refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Dark Chocolate Almond Truffles
ingredients_json: ["200 g Dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "100 ml Coconut milk, full fat", "50 g Almonds, finely chopped", "30 g Cocoa powder, unsweetened", "2 tbsp Honey"]
instructions: Begin by breaking the dark chocolate into small pieces and placing them in a heatproof bowl. In a small saucepan, heat the coconut milk over medium heat until it just starts to simmer, then pour it over the chocolate. Let it sit for 2 minutes to allow the chocolate to melt, then stir until smooth and fully combined. Add the honey and stir well to incorporate. Fold in the finely chopped almonds to give the mixture a nice crunch. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for about 2 hours or until the mixture is firm enough to roll into balls. Once chilled, use a teaspoon to scoop out small portions of the mixture and roll them into balls with your hands. If the mixture sticks, lightly wet your hands with water. Finally, roll each truffle in the unsweetened cocoa powder to coat evenly. Place the truffles on a tray lined with parchment paper and refrigerate for another 30 minutes to set before serving.

title: Dark Chocolate Avocado Truffles
ingredients_json: ["200 g Dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "2 medium Avocados, ripe (about 300 g flesh)", "30 g Honey, pure", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "30 g Cocoa powder, unsweetened (for rolling)"]
instructions: Start by melting the dark chocolate in a heatproof bowl over a double boiler on low heat, stirring occasionally until fully melted and smooth. While the chocolate melts, scoop out the flesh of the ripe avocados into a separate bowl and mash them until completely smooth with no lumps. Once the chocolate is melted, remove it from the heat and let it cool slightly for about 2 minutes. Stir the mashed avocado, honey, and vanilla extract into the melted chocolate until the mixture is well combined and silky. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, or until the mixture is firm enough to scoop. After chilling, use a small spoon or melon baller to scoop out portions of the mixture and roll them into bite-sized balls with your hands. Roll each truffle in unsweetened cocoa powder to coat evenly. Place the finished truffles on a tray lined with parchment paper. Refrigerate for another 30 minutes to set before serving. Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days.

title: Dark Chocolate Almond Truffles
ingredients_json: ["200 g Dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "100 ml Coconut milk, canned", "50 g Almonds, raw, finely chopped", "30 g Cocoa powder, unsweetened, for rolling", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "20 g Honey"]
instructions: Start by breaking the dark chocolate into small pieces and placing them in a heatproof bowl. In a small saucepan, heat the coconut milk over medium heat until it just begins to simmer, then pour it over the chocolate. Let it sit for a minute to allow the chocolate to soften, then stir gently until fully melted and smooth. Add the vanilla extract and honey, stirring to combine. Fold in the finely chopped almonds for a bit of crunch. Cover the mixture and refrigerate for about 2 hours or until it is firm enough to scoop. Once chilled, use a small spoon or melon baller to scoop out portions of the mixture and roll them into bite-sized balls with your hands. If the mixture sticks, lightly dampen your hands with water. Place the cocoa powder in a shallow dish and roll each truffle in it to coat evenly. Place the finished truffles on a parchment-lined tray and refrigerate for another 30 minutes to set. Serve chilled or at room temperature for a rich, fudgy texture.

title: Dark Chocolate Avocado Truffles
ingredients_json: ["200 g Dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "1 piece Avocado, ripe, medium size (about 150 g flesh)", "2 tbsp Honey", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "30 g Cocoa powder, unsweetened, for coating"]
instructions: Start by melting the dark chocolate in a heatproof bowl over a double boiler on low heat, stirring occasionally until smooth. While the chocolate melts, scoop out the avocado flesh into a separate bowl and mash it until completely smooth with no lumps. Once the chocolate is melted, remove it from the heat and let it cool slightly for about 2 minutes. Stir the mashed avocado, honey, and vanilla extract into the melted chocolate until the mixture is well combined and glossy. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for about 1 hour or until the mixture is firm enough to roll. After chilling, use a small spoon or melon baller to scoop out portions of the mixture and roll them into bite-sized balls with your hands. Place the cocoa powder in a shallow dish and roll each truffle in the cocoa powder to coat evenly. Place the truffles on a tray lined with parchment paper. Refrigerate for another 30 minutes to set before serving. Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the fridge for up to a week.

title: Spiced Apple and Walnut Upside-Down Cake
ingredients_json: ["2 medium Apples, fresh, peeled and sliced", "50 g Walnuts, chopped", "100 g Brown sugar", "50 g Unsalted butter", "150 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Rolled oats", "2 piece Egg, raw", "100 ml Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "50 ml Honey", "1 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "0.5 tsp Nutmeg, ground", "1 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Baking soda", "1 pinch Salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Grease a 20 cm round cake tin and set aside. In a small saucepan, melt 25 g of the unsalted butter with 50 g of brown sugar over medium heat, stirring until it forms a caramel-like mixture. Pour this mixture into the bottom of the cake tin, spreading it evenly. Arrange the sliced apples in a circular pattern over the caramel, then sprinkle the chopped walnuts on top. In a large mixing bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg, and a pinch of salt. In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, Greek yogurt, honey, and the remaining 25 g of melted unsalted butter until smooth. Gradually fold the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients, mixing until just combined; do not overmix. Pour the batter over the apples and walnuts in the cake tin, smoothing the top with a spatula. Bake in the preheated oven for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean and the top is golden brown. Allow the cake to cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then carefully invert it onto a serving plate. Serve warm or at room temperature for the best texture and flavor.

title: Healthy Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
ingredients_json: ["200 g Fresh pineapple, sliced", "100 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Almond flour", "100 g Greek yogurt, plain, non-fat", "2 piece Egg, raw", "50 g Honey", "30 ml Coconut oil, melted", "1 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Baking soda", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "0.25 tsp Ground cinnamon"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Lightly grease a 20 cm round cake pan with a small amount of coconut oil. Arrange the pineapple slices in a single layer at the bottom of the pan, cutting them to fit if necessary. In a medium bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, almond flour, baking powder, baking soda, and cinnamon. In a separate bowl, beat the eggs with the honey until light and fluffy, then mix in the Greek yogurt, melted coconut oil, and vanilla extract until well combined. Gradually fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture, stirring gently until just combined to avoid overmixing. Pour the batter evenly over the pineapple slices in the pan. Bake in the preheated oven for 30-35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean and the top is golden brown. Allow the cake to cool in the pan for 10 minutes before carefully inverting it onto a serving plate. Let it cool completely before slicing and serving.

title: Healthy Pineapple Upside-Down Cake with Almond Flour
ingredients_json: ["400 g Pineapple slices, canned in juice, drained", "150 g Almond flour", "100 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Honey", "3 pieces Egg, raw", "100 ml Greek yogurt, plain, non-fat", "50 ml Coconut oil, melted", "1 tsp Baking powder", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "1 pinch Ground cinnamon"]

Arrange the drained pineapple slices in a single layer at the bottom of the tin, ensuring they cover the base evenly. In a large mixing bowl, combine the almond flour, whole wheat flour, and baking powder. In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, honey, Greek yogurt, melted coconut oil, vanilla extract, and a pinch of cinnamon until smooth. Gradually fold the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients, mixing until just combined to avoid overmixing the batter. Pour the batter over the pineapple slices in the tin, spreading it evenly with a spatula. Bake in the preheated oven for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean and the top is golden brown. Allow the cake to cool in the tin for 10 minutes before carefully inverting it onto a serving plate. Let it cool completely before slicing and serving.

title: Peach and Almond Upside-Down Cake
ingredients_json: ["400 g Peaches, fresh, sliced", "50 g Almonds, sliced", "100 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g All-purpose flour", "150 g Cane sugar", "100 g Unsalted butter", "2 pieces Egg, raw", "1 dl Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "1 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Baking soda", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "0.5 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "1 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Grease a 23 cm round cake pan with a bit of butter and line the bottom with parchment paper. Arrange the sliced peaches in an even layer at the bottom of the pan, then sprinkle the sliced almonds over them. In a small saucepan, melt 50 g of the butter with 50 g of cane sugar over low heat, stirring until combined. Pour this mixture over the peaches and almonds, ensuring it spreads evenly. In a large mixing bowl, cream together the remaining 100 g of sugar and 50 g of butter until light and fluffy, which should take about 3 minutes with an electric mixer. Beat in the eggs one at a time, followed by the vanilla extract and Greek yogurt. In a separate bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, baking powder, baking soda, and cinnamon. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture, stirring just until combined. Be careful not to overmix. Spoon the batter over the peach layer in the pan, smoothing the top with a spatula. Bake in the preheated oven for 35 to 40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean and the top is golden brown. Let the cake cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then carefully invert it onto a serving plate. Peel off the parchment paper and let it cool completely before slicing. Serve with a drizzle of lemon juice for a refreshing touch.

title: Healthy Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
ingredients_json: ["400 g Pineapple slices, canned in juice", "150 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Almond flour", "100 g Coconut sugar", "2 piece Egg, raw", "100 ml Greek yogurt, plain, non-fat", "50 ml Coconut oil, melted", "1 tsp Baking powder", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "1 tsp Ground cinnamon", "50 g Walnuts, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C. Lightly grease a 23 cm round cake tin with a bit of coconut oil. Arrange the pineapple slices in a single layer at the bottom of the tin, cutting them as needed to fit snugly. Sprinkle the chopped walnuts over the pineapple. In a large mixing bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, almond flour, baking powder, and ground cinnamon. In a separate bowl, whisk together the coconut sugar, eggs, Greek yogurt, melted coconut oil, and vanilla extract until smooth. Gradually fold the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients, stirring until just combined to avoid overmixing. Pour the batter over the pineapple and walnut layer in the tin, smoothing the top with a spatula. Bake for 35-40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Let the cake cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then carefully invert it onto a serving plate. Allow it to cool completely before slicing and serving.

title: Oatmeal Banana Whoopie Pies with Yogurt Cream
ingredients_json: ["100 g rolled oats", "150 g whole wheat flour", "2 pieces bananas, ripe, medium size", "50 g brown sugar", "50 ml vegetable oil", "1 piece egg, raw", "5 g baking powder", "2 g baking soda", "2 g cinnamon, ground", "1 g salt", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, non-fat", "30 g honey", "5 ml vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large mixing bowl, mash the ripe bananas until smooth, then add the brown sugar, vegetable oil, and egg, mixing well to combine. In a separate bowl, whisk together the rolled oats, whole wheat flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt. Gradually fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture until just combined, being careful not to overmix. Using a spoon or small ice cream scoop, drop rounded tablespoons of batter onto the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 5 cm apart. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until the edges are lightly golden and the centers spring back when touched. Remove from the oven and let them cool completely on a wire rack. While the cookies cool, prepare the filling by mixing the Greek yogurt, honey, and vanilla extract in a small bowl until smooth. Once the cookies are cool, spread or pipe a generous dollop of the yogurt cream onto the flat side of half of the cookies, then sandwich with another cookie on top. Refrigerate for 30 minutes to set the filling before serving.

title: Dark Chocolate Oatmeal Whoopie Pies with Vanilla Cream
ingredients_json: ["100 g rolled oats, whole grain", "150 g whole wheat flour", "50 g cocoa powder, unsweetened", "1 tsp baking powder", "0.5 tsp baking soda", "100 g brown sugar", "100 g unsalted butter, softened", "1 piece egg, raw", "100 ml buttermilk, low-fat", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2% fat", "50 g powdered sugar", "1 tsp vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line two baking sheets with parchment paper. In a medium bowl, mix the rolled oats, whole wheat flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and baking soda until well combined. In a separate large bowl, beat the softened butter with the brown sugar using an electric mixer on medium speed for about 2 minutes until light and fluffy. Add the egg and 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract, and beat for another minute until fully incorporated. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture in three batches, alternating with the buttermilk, starting and ending with the dry ingredients. Mix until just combined, being careful not to overmix. Using a small cookie scoop or spoon, drop rounded tablespoons of batter onto the prepared baking sheets, spacing them about 5 cm apart. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until the tops are set and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Allow the cakes to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely. While the cakes cool, prepare the filling by mixing the Greek yogurt, powdered sugar, and the remaining teaspoon of vanilla extract in a small bowl until smooth. Once the cakes are completely cool, spread or pipe about a tablespoon of the vanilla cream filling onto the flat side of half of the cakes, then sandwich with another cake on top. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

title: Chocolate Oat Whoopie Pies with Yogurt Filling
ingredients_json: ["100 g rolled oats", "150 g whole wheat flour", "50 g cocoa powder, unsweetened", "1 tsp baking powder", "0.5 tsp baking soda", "100 g brown sugar", "2 pieces egg, raw", "100 ml vegetable oil", "200 ml buttermilk, low-fat", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2% fat", "50 g honey", "1 tsp lemon zest"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line two baking sheets with parchment paper. In a large bowl, mix the rolled oats, whole wheat flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and baking soda until combined. In a separate bowl, whisk together the brown sugar, eggs, vegetable oil, buttermilk, and vanilla extract until smooth. Gradually add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients, stirring just until a thick batter forms. Using a spoon or small ice cream scoop, drop rounded tablespoons of batter onto the prepared baking sheets, spacing them about 5 cm apart to allow for spreading. Bake for 8-10 minutes, or until the cookies are set and spring back lightly when touched. Remove from the oven and let them cool completely on a wire rack. While the cookies cool, prepare the filling by mixing the Greek yogurt, honey, and lemon zest in a small bowl until well combined. Once the cookies are cool, spread or pipe a generous dollop of the yogurt filling on the flat side of half the cookies, then sandwich with another cookie on top. Store in the refrigerator until ready to serve.

title: Cocoa Oatmeal Whoopie Pies with Yogurt Filling
ingredients_json: ["100 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Rolled oats", "30 g Cocoa powder, unsweetened", "1 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Baking soda", "100 g Brown sugar", "2 piece Egg, raw", "60 ml Vegetable oil, canola", "120 ml Buttermilk, low-fat", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, non-fat", "30 g Honey", "1 tsp Lemon zest"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large mixing bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, cocoa powder, baking powder, and baking soda. Stir well to ensure there are no lumps. In a separate bowl, whisk together the brown sugar, eggs, vegetable oil, buttermilk, and vanilla extract until smooth.
